national.headline: CTD kills Kohat attack mastermind
national.line: The Counter Terrorism Department killed three militants, including the mastermind of the September Kohat Police Lines attack, during an intelligence-based operation.

national.headline: Natural resources valued at $8-10 trillion
national.line: Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar estimated the value of Pakistan's natural resources at $8 to $10 trillion, calling it a conservative figure.

national.headline: Afghanistan excluded from ECO meeting
national.line: The Foreign Office confirmed Afghanistan was not invited to the Economic Cooperation Organisation meeting because Pakistan does not recognise the current Taliban government.

national.headline: Short-term inflation rises to 10.41pc
national.line: Official data shows short-term inflation reached 10.41 percent year-on-year, primarily driven by rising prices of wheat flour.

national.headline: Army Chief vows to eliminate terrorism in KP
national.line: During a visit to North Waziristan, the Army Chief reaffirmed the military's resolve to eliminate terrorism and restore stability in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

national.headline: Suspect arrested for selling US government data
national.line: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency arrested a suspect in Karachi for illegally acquiring and selling sensitive data from US agencies and companies.

national.headline: Lahore faces hazardous air quality
national.line: Lahore recorded an hourly air quality index of 465 as heavy smog severely impacted public health across several Punjab cities.

national.headline: Government and JI finalize fuel relief talks
national.line: The government and Jamaat-i-Islami have drafted a relief package for small farmers and owners of vehicles under 1,000cc.

international.headline: Indian national jailed for US murder plot
international.line: A US court sentenced an Indian national to 19 years in prison for plotting to assassinate a Sikh separatist on American soil.

international.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin hold trilateral summit
international.line: The leaders of the US, China, and Russia held a rare 90-minute trilateral summit in Shenzhen to discuss global security and power dynamics.

international.headline: US panel criticizes India's voter roll revisions
international.line: A US religious freedom commission reported that India is targeting religious minorities by removing millions of names from national voter rolls.

international.headline: Pakistan condemns Houthi attack on Riyadh
international.line: Pakistan officially condemned the Houthi missile strike on a major skyscraper in Riyadh, labeling the aggression a violation of Saudi sovereignty.

international.headline: UN warns against restricting freedom of association
international.line: The UN Human Rights Committee reminded nations that they cannot legally restrict civil society groups through mandatory state authorization or misuse of anti-terror laws.

international.headline: Potatoes grown in simulated lunar soil
international.line: Scientists have successfully grown potatoes in simulated moon soil, marking a potential breakthrough for sustainable food production in future space missions.
